body: [watermelon-full-preview] Landed 2026-11-12 in 77f7d761 (series tip 323fcc6b on main). send --supersede-key in both editions: enqueue sets aside every still-pending prompt with the same key into cancelled/ as superseded with superseded_by (listed in the send output's superseded); settled history and composer-stranded prompts untouched; replacement takes its own fresh queue place. Rust routes keyed prompts to inbox.v2 like --ttl; Python honours the key in its classic inbox. Schema regenerated. Tests: queue replace/order/stranded cases, drain types newest only, CLI parse, py supersede + schema, cross differential queue-supersede both editions (294+248+357+104 paired checks locally; gate herdr-agent differential green). Gates: full --all (gate9, 245 PASS; reds only wrkslots/lifecycle quarantine class plus solo-passed load flakes) and path-selected (gate15) with every non-quarantine red solo-passed on its gated tree. Deploy to live watchers/services is the coordinators' step.
